# Genomics {#sec-genomics}

::: {.callout-note title="From the exam description"}
Methods for sequencing, algorithms for assembly, gene predictions, etc.
:::

## Introduction

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Short introduction: from Sanger sequencing to short-read and long-read
technologies; how reads become genomes (assembly) or are placed on a
reference (mapping); calling variants; finding genes.
:::

## Key concepts

- Sequencing technologies: Sanger, pyrosequencing/454, Illumina (sequencing by synthesis), PacBio (HiFi), Oxford Nanopore; read lengths, error profiles, cost
- Shotgun sequencing; coverage (Lander–Waterman); paired-end and mate-pair reads
- Assembly paradigms: overlap–layout–consensus, string graphs, de Bruijn graphs; repeats as the central problem; scaffolding
- Assembly quality: N50, BUSCO, Assemblathon; telomere-to-telomere assemblies; haplotype-resolved assembly
- Read mapping: hashing/seeds vs. Burrows–Wheeler/FM-index (Bowtie, BWA), long-read mapping (minimap2); mapping quality
- Variant calling: SNPs, indels, structural variants; genotype likelihoods; GATK; deep-learning callers
- Gene prediction: ab initio (HMM-based: GeneMark, GENSCAN), homology- and RNA-seq-based evidence; prokaryotic vs. eukaryotic gene finding
- Metagenomics (overview)

## Key papers

::: {.callout-tip}
★ = mandatory in earlier reading lists.
:::

### Reviews — start here

- @goodwin2016 — ten years of next-generation sequencing technologies.
- @compeau2011 — how to apply de Bruijn graphs to genome assembly.

### Sequencing technologies

- @sanger1977 — chain-terminating sequencing.
- @smith1986 — fluorescence detection in automated sequencing.
- @ronaghi1998 — pyrosequencing.
- @margulies2005 — 454 sequencing in picolitre reactors.
- @bentley2008 — Illumina reversible-terminator chemistry.
- @jain2018 — nanopore sequencing of a human genome with ultra-long reads.

### Genome assembly

- @anson1999 — algorithms for whole-genome shotgun sequencing.
- @myers2000 — whole-genome assembly of *Drosophila*.
- @pevzner2001 — an Eulerian path approach to assembly.
- ★ @myers2005 — the fragment assembly string graph.
- @zerbino2008 — Velvet: de Bruijn graph assembly of short reads.
- @bradnam2013 — Assemblathon 2: evaluating assemblers.
- @cheng2021 — hifiasm: haplotype-resolved assembly from HiFi reads.
- @nurk2022 — the complete (telomere-to-telomere) human genome.

### Read mapping and variant calling

- ★ @langmead2009 — Bowtie: ultrafast BWT-based alignment.
- @li2009 — BWA.
- @li2018 — minimap2.
- @li2008 — mapping quality and variant calling (MAQ).
- @marth1999 — a general approach to SNP discovery.
- @li2011 — a statistical framework for SNP calling.
- @depristo2011 — GATK: variation discovery and genotyping.
- @poplin2018 — DeepVariant: variant calling with a deep neural network.

### Gene prediction

- @burge1997 — GENSCAN: gene structure prediction in human genomic DNA.
- ★ @lukashin1998 — GeneMark.hmm.
